checks.observation: Capacities 85,72,56,53 give respectively 2380,2016,1568,1484 incidence bits and 2024785,1028790,367290,292825 four-subsets, exactly as printed. The baseline is 19n+868<=2240, so n<=floor(1372/19)=72; n=72 gives 2236 while n=73 gives 2255. The counts describe two representation choices, not search-node counts, measured speedups, or exclusion certificates.
